public.text: The design principle focuses mainly on infrastructural participation and graceful degradation. Equity also concerns accessibility, language, disability, gender, affordability, digital literacy, and risk of discriminatory data practices.
public.suggestedRevision: Expand the principle to include accessible interfaces, multilingual support, assisted and non-digital pathways, affordability, disability inclusion, representative testing, and monitoring for differential outcomes across population groups.
